SOC It 2 Me

Hands-on SOC 2 readiness training for small and growing companies.

Type
Page
Edition
1.0
Published
November 12, 2026

Public · v0.1.2

SOC 2 readiness, as a course you can work through. Open training that takes a company from a customer's first "do you have a SOC 2 report?" to a clean first audit, without buying a compliance platform first. It's open on GitHub.

  • Who it's for: founders, operators, and the person who just became "the security owner" at a software or services company, plus trainers who want material to teach from.
  • What's in it: eight modules, each with an exercise on your own company; a map of 44 starter controls with owners, frequency, and evidence, tied to the SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria and ISO/IEC 27001:2022; evidence checklists by area; templates for risk, access, vendor, and incident work; a 90-day plan; and a workshop guide.
  • How it relates to Ready, Secure, Go: Ready, Secure, Go explains what SOC 2 is in plain words. SOC It 2 Me is the hands-on part: the work, the forms, and the evidence.
  • Licenses: written material under CC BY-SA 4.0, code under MIT, and the names reserved.

Current limits

It's readiness training, not audit or legal advice. Only a licensed CPA firm can issue a SOC 2 report. It doesn't yet cover the Processing Integrity or Privacy criteria.

Next step

For help applying it, neon1's SOC 2 readiness work maps controls, gathers evidence, and fixes the basics before the auditor arrives. Get in touch to talk it through.
